use default
use System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex

let swaps = MAP[string, string](
    [
        ("she", "he"), ("he", "she"),
        ("her", "him"), ("him", "her"),
        ("hers", "his"), ("his", "hers"),
        ("herself", "himself"), ("himself", "herself"),
        ("woman", "man"), ("man", "woman"),
        ("girl", "boy"), ("boy", "girl"),
        ("mother", "father"), ("father", "mother"),
        ("wife", "husband"), ("husband", "wife")
    ]
    |> map(((word, swap)) => KeyValuePair(word, swap)))

reverse_gender(text: string) -> string is
    let word_pattern = Regex("[A-Za-z]+")

    word_pattern.replace(text, m => (
        let word = m.value
        let lower = word.to_lower()

        if swaps.contains_key(lower) then
            let replacement = swaps[lower]

            if char.is_upper(word[0]) then
                "{char.to_upper(replacement[0])}{replacement[1..<0]}"
            else
                replacement
            fi
        else
            word
        fi
    ))

    "She was a soul stripper. She took my heart!"))
